The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operated a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]<ref name="GG9" /> '''base''' located in the [[Ansarra system/Legends|Ansarra system]].<ref name="TEOC" /> It was [[Attack on Ansarra Rebel base|attacked]] by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; during the engagement, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Freebooter]]'', [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Devon Fuller]], was wrecked.<ref name="GG9" />
